indicator: Antenatal care from a skilled provider
source_label: Antenatal care from a skilled provider
definition: Percentage of women who had a live birth (or stillbirth) in the two (or three/five) years preceding the survey who received antenatal care during the pregnancy for the most recent live birth from a skilled provider
Percentage of women who had a live birth (or stillbirth) in the two (or three/five) years preceding the survey who had 4+ antenatal care visits
Percentage of live births (or stillbirths) in the two (or three/five) years preceding the survey delivered at a health facility

source_label: Assistance during delivery from a skilled provider
definition: Percentage of live births (or stillbirths) in the two (or three/five) years preceding the survey assisted by a skilled provider. Skilled provider includes doctor, nurse, midwife and auxiliary nurse or midwife.

source_label: Mother's first postnatal checkup in the first two days after birth
definition: Percentage of women giving birth in the two years preceding the survey who had their first postnatal checkup within the first two days after birth
Percentage of children 12-23 (or 24-35) months who were fully vaccinated with 8 basic antigens (BCG, Polio 1-3, DPT 1-3, Measles)
Percentage of children 12-23 [or 24-35] months who had received no vaccinations

indicator: Children sleeping under a treated net
source_label: Children under 5 who slept under an insecticide-treated net (ITN)
definition: Percentage of children under age five who slept under an insecticide treated net (ITN) the night before the survey
Percentage of children stunted (below -2 SD of height for age according to the WHO standard)

Probability of dying in the first month of life in the five or ten years preceding the survey, per 1,000 live births. Estimates are given for ten year periods for all characteristics, but for five year periods only for the national total, by residence, and by sex.

Probability of dying before the fifth birthday in the five or ten years preceding the survey, per 1,000 live births. Estimates are given for ten year periods for all characteristics, but for five year periods only for the national total, by residence, and by sex.
Percentage of women who are literate

source_label: Married women currently using any modern method of contraception
definition: Percentage of currently married or in union women currently using any modern method of contraception
Total fertility rate for the three years preceding the survey for age group 15-49 expressed per woman
